title: Our First Album
description:
The office is buzzing. <blue>[album_group]</color> has released its first album, <blue>[album_title]</color>.

@actor_0@ lingers by the doorway, trying and failing to hide a grin. "President... we actually did it. An album. A real one."

SNS.text: first album celebrations are the cutest, they worked so hard for this!!

result.description: You call everyone into the lounge. Cheap cake, loud music, and exhausted smiles turn the release day into a memory nobody wants to leave.

options.tooltip: The release is only the beginning.

result.description: You congratulate the team, then remind them that the charts start moving now. The mood settles into determined excitement.

title: A Rival Enters the Album Market
description:
Industry news breaks across every feed: <blue>[album_rival]</color> has released a new album, <blue>[album_title]</color>.

Their rollout is polished, their fans are loud, and suddenly the album chart feels a lot more crowded.

options.tooltip: Keep an eye on the competition.

SNS.text: album season just got serious, everybody is dropping at once

result.description: You have the staff collect every ad, teaser, and chart update they can find. Competition is useful when you learn from it.
You close the article. Rival headlines do not make your next record better — work does.

title: Album Sales Are Slowing
description:
The latest chart report for <blue>[album_title]</color> is uncomfortable reading: only <blue>[album_sales]</color> new sales this period.

@actor_0@ looks worried. "Do you think people are already moving on?"

options.tooltip: Push the album harder while there is still time.

SNS.text: the extra album promos are everywhere lately... not complaining though

result.description: The marketing team scrambles together new clips, interviews, and social posts. Whether it changes the trend remains to be seen.

options.tooltip: Let the album find its audience naturally.

result.description: You decide not to panic. Not every record has to explode immediately — some grow slowly.

title: The Album Rollout Goes Wrong
description:
Something has gone badly off course with <blue>[album_title]</color>. Momentum has collapsed far faster than expected, and the staff are arguing over what went wrong.

@actor_0@ finally asks the question everyone is avoiding: "Can we still save it?"

options.tooltip: Rework the rollout before it gets worse.

result.description: Every department gets dragged into the conference room. By midnight, the whiteboard is covered in crossed-out plans and a brand-new recovery strategy.
You stop throwing resources at a campaign that is not landing. It stings, but the team starts thinking about what comes next.

title: Album Celebration Party
description:
<blue>[album_title]</color> has given <blue>[album_group]</color> a reason to celebrate. The chart result is strong enough that the staff are already asking what kind of party you want.

@actor_0@ is very clearly hoping the answer is "a big one."

SNS.text: THE ALBUM PARTY PHOTOS?? everyone looks so happy omg

result.description: The office turns into a party venue for one night. The team eats too much, takes too many photos, and celebrates like the next deadline does not exist.

options.tooltip: A smaller dinner with the team.

result.description: You book a quiet dinner instead. No press, no cameras — just the people who made the record happen.
You promise there will be a celebration later. The finance team is delighted. The idols are... less delighted.

title: Album Showcase Opportunity
description:
Demand around <blue>[album_title]</color> is strong enough for a dedicated showcase. A promoter offers a venue, while the media team argues that a livestream could reach even more fans.

@actor_0@ looks ready to perform either way.

SNS.text: the album showcase was SO good, hearing those songs live changed everything

result.description: The venue sells out faster than expected. For one night, the album stops being numbers on a chart and becomes a room full of people singing along.

SNS.text: thank you for streaming the showcase!! international fans finally won

result.description: Cameras, lights, and chat messages fill the studio. The audience is invisible, but the live counter keeps climbing.
You pass. The group keeps promoting through normal appearances instead.
